name: MacNull
oneLiner: MacNull is a native macOS cleaner built for developers: it finds and safely removes repo build output, dependency folders and dev-tool caches, and moves everything to the Trash by default.

features: Deep cleaning of code repositories (node_modules, target, build, .dart_tool, Pods, DerivedData)
Developer tool caches (npm, pnpm, Cargo, Gradle, pub, Homebrew, Xcode, AI coding tools)
Safety labels: Safe to Clean / Check First
Moves to Trash by default, restorable clean history
Skips files in use by other apps
Homebrew command-line tool uninstaller, app uninstaller, Space Lens, duplicates

primary: software developers on Mac (web, mobile, Rust, Flutter, iOS)

positioning.tone: plain, confident, short sentences; no fear-selling
differentiators: Understands repos and dev toolchains, not just ~/Library/Caches
Everything goes to the Trash first; nothing irreversible without saying so

avoid: brooms, sparkles, magic wands (category cliche and the inherited Mac Sai icon)
aggressive or destructive imagery (fire, explosions, shredders)

notes: Name: Mac + null (empty value / /dev/null). Fork of Mac Sai; the old purple broom icon is not equity for the new name. App UI is light-mode SwiftUI with systemBlue accents.
